verdict.rationale: Cekura documents agent-facing tooling: Skills and an MCP server let an AI assistant design and run voice-agent evaluations, and a CLI, SDK and OpenAPI spec manage scenarios and runs programmatically. That covers triggering an eval run. However, scenarios and evaluators only approximate a 'dataset', and no item shows reading back run results programmatically. Results comparison is documented only on the UI Results page. missing for 10: explicit dataset creation via API/MCP, documented programmatic retrieval of eval run results, end-to-end agent workflow example, independent hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can have an agent create a dataset, trigger an eval run programmatically, and read back the results

citations.quote: Install Cekura Skills and MCP so your AI assistant can design, run, and improve voice-agent evaluations.
Manage agents, scenarios, runs, and call data from your terminal
Programmatic access to Cekura — sync and async clients for application code
Whether you're using Claude Code, Cursor, or VS Code, you can manage your voice agent testing and observability directly from your development environment.
